text:
Elaine: quick heads-up — I'm about to open a docs PR to reconcile the audit-log redaction examples with the KMS section. noticed a mismatch where the snippet shows `kms:key-rot` but the legal wording expects `customer-managed-kms`. can someone from legal + eng-docs take a quick look?
Raj: on it. can you paste the snippet here so I can sanity-check the code/cli bits first?
Elaine: sure — snippet from the draft:
```
POST /v1/audit/export
{
  "destination": "s3://my-bucket/audit/",
  "encryption": { "type": "kms", "key": "kms:key-rot" },
  "redaction": ["user_email", "api_key"]
}
```
Elaine: legal wants the canonical name to be `customer-managed-kms` (we mention that in SOC2 section). also we should call out the rotate/rotate-policy note under key management.
Josh (legal): thanks, Elaine. please change the field name but also add a one-liner explaining that customers must provide a KMS key ARN/ID and that key rotation is subject to their KMS policy. from a compliance POV we can't imply Redwood rotates customer keys. suggest: `encryption.key_type: "customer-managed-kms" and add "kms_key_id" field example.`
Raj: makes sense. small nit — our SDK snippets (python/js) use `kms_key` variable already. we should keep the sample aligned: i.e., in curl/HTTP examples use `kms_key_id`.
Maria: I'll sync the SDK snippet in the code samples. will change variable name to `kms_key_id` and update the docs cross-ref. pinging @docs-bot to create the PR link once Elaine pushes. :email:
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 (draft) — title: "docs: harmonize KMS naming + audit export redaction examples"
docs-bot: Current files changed: docs/security/audit-exports.md, docs/reference/export-api.md, examples/sdk/python/audit_export.py
Elaine: thanks — @Josh (legal) can you confirm the short phrasing for the one-liner? i'll add to PR description so reviewers see the rationale.
Josh (legal): suggested wording: "Customers must supply a customer-managed KMS key (KMS key id/ARN) for server-side encryption of audit exports. Redwood does not rotate or have access to customer-managed keys; key lifecycle is managed by the customer and subject to their own rotation policies." Use that verbatim.
Raj: perfect. i'll also run the snippet through the linter and make sure we include a minimal curl example + py snippet parity.
Maria: quick checklist i'm applying before merge: update cross-links, add a short note in migration-guide about the field rename, adjust table of fields in export-api.md, and add a unit test for the example snippet in examples/sdk/python (just runs, doesn't hit infra).
Elaine: awesome. i'll push an updated commit with the wording, and include a migration note like: "Previously: `encryption.key` accepted generic values. Now: prefer `encryption.key_type: \"customer-managed-kms\"` and `encryption.kms_key_id` for the identifier."
Raj: left a tiny comment on the PR about code formatting in the md fenced block (remove trailing spaces).
docs-bot: CI checks: docs lint ✅, linkcheck ⚠️ (one broken link to old legal FAQ), spellcheck ✅, examples smoke test ⚠️ (one flaky test marked xfail).
Elaine: i'll fix the broken link and mark the flaky example as xfail in the test harness.
Josh (legal): approved the wording in-thread — will add formal approval in PR review. :white_check_mark:
Maria: updated the python example and pushed. PR now has two commits.
docs-bot: PR status: ready for review — reviewers requested: @raj, @josh_legal, @maria.
Elaine: thanks team. merging after one last lint pass. i'll follow up with a short changelog blurb and a docs-site banner for the change so customers searching audit/export see the updated KMS wording. :tada:
